content.comment_body: Hello, When I send an SMS to [product_name] from my iPhone, the module receives incorrect characters and returns an 'invalid command' response. For example, I sent 'DIAG?' but received a message containing unusual characters: 'Invalid Command'. This issue does not occur when I send the same SMS from an Android phone.

I also use an iPhone, but sending 'DIAG?' works properly for me. It might be related to your iPhone's regional settings. Which region is your device set to? I could change mine and test if I encounter the same issue. Could you also provide your iOS version and the firmware version of the [product_name]?

analysis.insight_summary: A user is experiencing problems with SMS commands sent from an iPhone to a [product_name], resulting in corrupted characters and an 'Invalid Command' reply. The same process works without errors from an Android phone. The discussion points toward differences in iPhone regional or language settings, which may affect SMS encoding and command interpretation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects SMS commands sent from any phone—especially an iPhone—to be accurately recognized and executed by the module, without character or encoding errors.
